title: explicit Guards Implicit Conversions
prompt: The starter's `Meters(int)` allows accidental implicit conversions like `Meters m = 42;`. Mark the constructor `explicit` (keep the user-defined literal working) so the tests prove conversions require intent.

tests.name: conversion requires intent
tests.hint: Add explicit to the constructor: Meters m = 42; becomes ill-formed, Meters m{42}; keeps working.

tests.name: the literal still constructs directly
tests.hint: In the literal, call Meters(static_cast<int>(m)) — direct-initialization, which explicit allows.
